note: The owner's rules in force for the XAUUSD advisory system, each with its source. Changed only by a reviewed PR in this repository.

rules.rule: The server never trades: no broker integration, no broker credential, no order and no position size in the Workers. Since 2026-11-09 the owner's own MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor may execute the H1 decision on the owner's terminal, sizing each trade from the owner's risk input, and Omega may pause or stop it. Aether, its reports and its learned knowledge stay advisory.
rules.source: xauusd AGENTS.md rule 8; owner decisions 2026-11-09 (Langsung siap live, EA MT5 di terminal Anda)

rules.rule: Reports to the platform kernel never carry price levels (entry, stop, target, zones, key levels).
Retired for the rooms on 2026-11-09: every room (15m included) is judged by its own quorum (h1_quorum, independent_rooms). The confirmation rule survives only in the legacy live room.
rules.source: xauusd src/war-room.mjs CONFIRMATION_RULE; owner decisions 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-09

rules.rule: The H1 decision is the quorum of the 1H War Room, independent of the TradingView webhooks, of parity approval and of any single indicator signal: BUY or SELL only when the moderator concluded it and more than the 1-hour room's quorum share (0.5 by default) of the weight of the agents who spoke holds the matching bias; otherwise WAIT. Indicator signals are the agents' arguments, never gates or vetoes. Prices come from the 1-hour chart's own key-level zones; without a valid entry, stop and target the decision is WAIT.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, The H1 decision is the room's quorum; owner decision 2026-11-09

rules.rule: Every timeframe's room is independent: its agents read only that timeframe's own data, never another timeframe's room, desk or decision and never another agent; the Consensus Discussion stays inside each timeframe over an anonymous bus, and every answer names the metrics it decided from, never an agent.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, Independent rooms; owner decisions 2026-11-09

rules.rule: Every opening states its action and its bias (BULLISH, BEARISH or NEUTRAL): the direction its own data leans, even when the action is WAIT.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, Bias beside the action

rules.rule: A BUY or SELL conclusion needs at least one agent holding that stance; a BULLISH or BEARISH bias needs at least one agent holding it.

Agents never mention calibration, parity or verification in their text; readers see each agent's calibration status once, next to its name. In the Live War Room 15m an agent with no calibrated statement speaks at confidence 0.4 or lower; the 1H, 4H and D1 rooms have no such cap (owner decision 2026-11-09).
Each HUD or indicator agent analyses only the data its own HUD or indicator produces.
Without a usable closed candle, or without a quorum, the H1 decision is WAIT, never a guess.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, H1 chain; owner decision 2026-11-09

rules.rule: Local engine trust comes only from the parity registry (24 consecutive matching candles); nothing is marked verified by hand, and the Pine sources and hashed engines are never edited.

No change to an engine parameter, a prompt or a knowledge item is promoted automatically: candidates run in shadow, are judged by outcome scoring with a significance test, and the owner approves a separate promotion PR. The one exception is the room quorum weighting (weighting_auto).

The quorum weighting of every room (each agent's own weight on its timeframe, in the bar's volatility and trend regime, and the quorum share) is tuned automatically per timeframe over a reviewed grid, without an operator: xauusd activates a point its replay rates better on discovery and holdout, at most once a week, rolls a worse one back in reverse shadow, and tells the owner on Telegram. Aether audits the reports and proposes nothing.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, Room quorum weighting; owner decisions 2026-11-09

rules.rule: Learned knowledge is labelled as learned, cites its evidence, and never redefines a field or a rule of the canon.
Calls to the platform kernel use RPC Service Bindings without shared secrets; reports are info or warning, never critical; a denial is final (no retry, no switching agent ids).
